Lemma
[Orthonormal Basis Adapted to a Non-Null Line]

↗ lem:adapted-orthonormal-basis

If $\dim V=n\ge 1$ and $\langle x,x\rangle \ne 0$, then $V$ has an orthonormal basis $(b_i)$ with $\operatorname {span}(b_1)=\operatorname {span}(x)$.
Proof

↗ lem:adapted-orthonormal-basis \sketch The hypothesis makes $x$ nonzero and its line nondegenerate: $cx$ orthogonal to $x$ forces $c=0$. Apply Lemma 17 with $k=1$.

□
